title: Cross-validate: GCP Handoff COSE_Sign1 parity
description: Cross-validate GCP Handoff COSE_Sign1 across Python, Rust, and C. (1) All three implementations must produce identical COSE_Sign1 bytes for the same inputs (canonical CBOR payload + same signing key → same signature); (2) each implementation must successfully verify messages signed by the other two; (3) test against every vector in gcp_handoff_cose_sign1.json from all three consumers; (4) verify replay rejection, expiry enforcement, and kid/alg validation are consistent across implementations. Depends on 3o0p.2 and 3o0p.3.
